products.title: Ben Nye Temporary Hair Color
products.description: No-Commitment Color Actor needs a little salt and pepper for the scene? Before you buy a wig you'll never use again, reach for this Hair Color from Ben Nye and get the grays you need in an instant! This professional quality hair color temporarily coats the hair in pigment without flaking or fading, and will show up on all hair levels (although a strip test is recommended for those with chemically treated hair). Perfect for highlighting, aging, and filling in sparse areas, this hair color is a must-have in your makeup kit! Hair Color For High Quality Visual Effects This Ben Nye Hair Color dries on its own and is easily removed with shampoo and warm water. This formula is best utilized by stage, cosplay, and character makeup artists. When using Hair Colors on color-treated or bleached hair, apply a strip test before full application. For small streaks of color, comb colors through the hair with a disposable mascara wand. When applying full coverage color over the hair, pour Hair Color into a bowl, and apply color with a hair color brush or fine-tooth brush. To increase the durability of colors, seal with Final Seal and hairspray.
